title: donoteat this BONUS EPISODE 2: KILLDOZER!
description:
the patreons have spoken, so here's an episode about Marvin Heemeyer's KILLDOZER, though it's really actually about poop.

here is the link to the patreon if you pirated the episode and feel bad: https://www.patreon.com/donoteat

The credits and killdozer feature montage music is Tragic Overture, Op. 81, by Johannes Brahms. It is the version by the Musopen Symphony, and is in the public domain. You can find the recording here: 
https://musopen.org/music/2120-tragic-overture-op-81/

the other music is from minecraft
